signatures.title: Signatures & stamp
signatures.lead: The clinic stamp and each doctor's signature, printed on prescriptions, medical reports, certificates and invoices.
signatures.lead_doctor: Your signature is printed on the prescriptions, reports and certificates you issue.
signatures.privacy_note: Only members of this clinic can see these images. A document only ever carries the signature of the doctor who issued it.
signatures.stamp_sub: A scan or photo of the clinic's stamp, printed beside the doctor's signature.
signatures.stamp_help: PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB. A PNG with a transparent background looks best.
signatures.stamp_replace_confirm: The new stamp will be printed on documents from now on.
signatures.stamp_remove_confirm: Documents printed from now on will have an empty stamp box.
signatures.places_help: Choose where the stamp appears. Documents already printed are not affected.
signatures.doctors_sub: Upload a scanned signature or draw it on the screen. Each doctor can also manage their own signature.
signatures.my_sub: Upload a scanned signature or draw it on the screen with your finger, a stylus or the mouse.
signatures.no_doctors_text: Add the clinic's doctors first, then come back to add their signatures.
signatures.not_linked: Your account is not linked to a doctor
signatures.not_linked_text: Ask the clinic owner to link your login to your doctor profile to add your signature.
signatures.upload_help: PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB. Sign in dark ink on white paper and crop close to the signature.
signatures.draw_help: Sign inside the box, then save.
signatures.replace_confirm: The new signature will be printed on documents from now on.
signatures.remove_confirm: Documents printed from now on will have an empty signature line for {name}.
signatures.too_big: The image is larger than 1 MB.
signatures.wrong_type: Use a PNG or JPEG image.
signatures.profile_sub: Printed on this doctor's prescriptions, reports and certificates.

errors_signatures.IMAGE_TOO_BIG: The image is larger than 1 MB.
errors_signatures.IMAGE_INVALID: The file is not a valid PNG or JPEG image.
errors_signatures.IMAGE_DIMENSIONS: The image must be between 16 and 4000 pixels on each side.
errors_signatures.PERMISSION_DENIED: You can only manage your own signature.
